'''''Clean Sweep''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Comet Broom Service]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was based on [[Artom Station]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="LF" />
